_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Optimizing the Workday "M" Curve Report
summary: This report is used by the shipyard and government to measure, identify, and act upon detractors that prevent the workforce from being on jobsite working.
use_relationship:
This report will be used by the shipyard and government to measure, identify and act upon detractors that prevent workforce from being on jobsite working.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be presented in a format similar to that of Figure 1.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain all information specified in Figure 1 and the following:

children.title: Graphical display of the ideal "M" curve vs. measured "M" curve for total production workforce assigned broken out by trade, referred to as Resource Allocation Process (RAP).
children.content: The ideal "M" curve is defined as the most optimal, achievable curve when all negative constraints are removed.

children.title: Graphic shall display Ideal M curve vs. measured "M" curve, along with Delta, for:
Beginning of ship ramp up time to peak manning (AM time to Peak shown in minutes)
Time duration at peak manning prior to lunch (AM duration at Peak shown in minutes)
Comparison of "measured peak" vs. "expected peak" prior to lunch (AM peak manning (% RAP #))
Prior to lunch ramp-down time from peak manning (AM time from peak to lunch shown in minutes)
After lunch ramp-up time to peak manning (PM time to peak shown in minutes)
Time duration at peak manning after lunch (PM duration at peak shown in minutes)
Comparison of "measured peak" vs. "expected peak" after lunch (PM peak manning (% RAP #))
Prior to end of shift ramp-down time from peak manning (PM time from peak to end of shift shown in minutes)

preparation_instructions.title: Media requirements.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be presented in electronic media, Adobe Reader 9 or compatible portable document file (.pdf).
